mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO symbol (exchange, symbol, base_asset, quote_asset, is_active) VALUES
(#{r.exchange}, #{r.symbol}, #{r.baseAsset}, #{r.quoteAsset}, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_asset = VALUES(base_asset), quote_asset = VALUES(quote_asset), is_active = 1

INSERT INTO price_candle (symbol_id, interval_code, open_time, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, quote_volume, taker_buy_volume) VALUES
(#{symbolId}, #{interval}, #{k.openTime}, #{k.open}, #{k.high}, #{k.low}, #{k.close}, #{k.volume}, #{k.quoteVolume}, #{k.takerBuyVolume})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), quote_volume = VALUES(quote_volume), taker_buy_volume = VALUES(taker_buy_volume)

INSERT INTO funding_rate (symbol_id, funding_time, funding_rate, mark_price) VALUES
(#{r.symbolId}, #{r.fundingTime}, #{r.fundingRate}, #{r.markPrice})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE funding_rate = VALUES(funding_rate), mark_price = COALESCE(VALUES(mark_price), mark_price)

INSERT INTO open_interest (symbol_id, period, ts, oi_amount, oi_value_usd) VALUES
(#{r.symbolId}, #{r.period}, #{r.ts}, #{r.oiAmount}, #{r.oiValueUsd})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE oi_amount = VALUES(oi_amount), oi_value_usd = VALUES(oi_value_usd)

INSERT INTO long_short_ratio (symbol_id, ratio_type, period, ts, long_ratio, short_ratio, long_short) VALUES
(#{r.symbolId}, #{r.ratioType}, #{r.period}, #{r.ts}, #{r.longRatio}, #{r.shortRatio}, #{r.longShort})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE long_ratio = VALUES(long_ratio), short_ratio = VALUES(short_ratio), long_short = VALUES(long_short)

INSERT INTO liquidation (symbol_id, side, price, quantity, value_usd, event_time) VALUES
(#{r.symbolId}, #{r.side}, #{r.price}, #{r.quantity}, #{r.valueUsd}, #{r.eventTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.symbol, l.side, l.price, l.quantity, l.value_usd, l.event_time FROM liquidation l JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = l.symbol_id WHERE l.event_time >= #{since} ORDER BY l.event_time ASC, l.liquidation_id ASC

SELECT s.symbol, f.funding_rate AS last_rate, f.funding_time AS last_time, a.avg_rate, a.cnt FROM ( SELECT symbol_id, MAX(funding_time) AS mt, AVG(funding_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM funding_rate WHERE funding_time >= #{since} GROUP BY symbol_id ) a JOIN funding_rate f ON f.symbol_id = a.symbol_id AND f.funding_time = a.mt JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = a.symbol_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_signal (symbol_id, signal_type, level, direction, reason, evidence_json, price_at, detected_at) VALUES (#{symbolId}, #{signalType}, #{level}, #{direction}, #{reason}, #{evidenceJson}, #{priceAt}, #{detectedAt})

INSERT INTO ai_report (symbol_id, report_type, summary, scenarios, overheat_level, risks, input_json, model, created_at) VALUES (#{symbolId}, #{reportType}, #{summary}, #{scenarios}, #{overheatLevel}, #{risks}, #{inputJson}, #{model}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, s.symbol FROM market_signal m JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = m.symbol_id WHERE m.detected_at >= #{since} AND ( (m.price_1h IS NULL AND m.detected_at <= #{now} - 3600000) OR (m.price_4h IS NULL AND m.detected_at <= #{now} - 14400000) OR (m.price_24h IS NULL AND m.detected_at <= #{now} - 86400000)) ORDER BY m.detected_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE market_signal SET price_1h = COALESCE(#{price1h}, price_1h), price_4h = COALESCE(#{price4h}, price_4h), price_24h = COALESCE(#{price24h}, price_24h) WHERE signal_id = #{signalId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'market_signal' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('price_1h', 'price_4h', 'price_24h')
SELECT s.symbol, f.funding_time AS ts, f.funding_rate AS v FROM funding_rate f JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = f.symbol_id WHERE f.funding_time >= #{since} ORDER BY s.symbol, f.funding_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backtest_run (symbol_id, signal_type, start_time, end_time, hold_minutes, take_profit, stop_loss, params_json, status) VALUES (#{symbolId}, #{signalType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{holdMinutes}, #{takeProfit}, #{stopLoss}, #{paramsJson}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE backtest_run SET status = #{status} WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backtest_result (run_id, signal_count, win_count, win_rate, avg_return, total_return, max_drawdown, period_json) VALUES (#{runId}, #{signalCount}, #{winCount}, #{winRate}, #{avgReturn}, #{totalReturn}, #{maxDrawdown}, #{periodJson})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.symbol, b.signal_count, b.win_count, b.win_rate, b.avg_return, b.total_return, b.max_drawdown FROM backtest_run r LEFT JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = r.symbol_id LEFT JOIN backtest_result b ON b.run_id = r.run_id ORDER BY r.run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.*, s.symbol, b.signal_count, b.win_count, b.win_rate, b.avg_return, b.total_return, b.max_drawdown, b.period_json FROM backtest_run r LEFT JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol_id = r.symbol_id LEFT JOIN backtest_result b ON b.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.run_id = #{runId}
